notes: This suite is the answer to 'was the logistic-head result an artefact of an almost-convex two-parameter model?'
Ranked by final test loss (metric = test_loss); epochs_to_target at 0.143 is reported alongside and verified too.

WARNING, and the reason this suite is useful: on seed 7 the pinned numbers favour ademamix_warmup_45, but over 10 seeds it is the second-worst arm (mean test loss 0.14269 +/- 0.03485 against AdamW's 0.13218 +/- 0.02473). The seed-7 values are a regression baseline only - the verdict comes from runs/mlp-verified/ademamix/seed-sweep-summary.md, not from this file.

10-seed verdict: the speed claim is not reproduced (AdEMAMix and AdamW reach the target within 0-12 epochs of each other and momentum is faster than both), and the paper's warmup scheme is clearly worse at this budget on both trainers (logistic and MLP). The no-warmup AdEMAMix is indistinguishable from AdamW (0.13249 vs 0.13218).
